# Arab University Rankings 2024
#### **Explore the top ranked universities in the Arab region**
Discover the top universities in the Arab region with the *Times Higher Education *Arab University Rankings 2024. This year we've ranked 238 institutions from 16 countries or territories. The methodology is based on the same framework as our World University Rankings, but some adjustments have been made and some new metrics have been included to reect the features and missions of universities in the Middle East and North Africa.
#### **Arab University Rankings 2024: key insights**
- **KAUST** in Saudi Arabia is number one in the Arab region, thanks to strong performances in the research environment, society and research quality pillars - **Saudi Arabian universities** take ve of the top 10 spots, including all of the top three - **Jordan** has a university in the top 10 for the rst time. The University of Jordan has risen to ninth place with particularly strong performances in the research environment and society pillars - **Ahlia University** in Bahrain is the highest-ranking new entrant at joint 17th thanks to high scores in the research quality and society pillars
